equivalent_mutants.reason: Coordinator review against hash-verified v1.0 0x42cab0: entry ESP-4 is the private SEH construction-state word, initialized by PUSH -1 at 0x42cab6; stores at 0x42cb51/0x42cb66/0x42cb89 set states 0/1/2. The registered 0x505511 handler and 0x5054f0/0x5054fb/0x505506 cleanup funclets consume it only on guest exception unwinding, which the ordinary canonical ABI does not transport. This review covers normal-return behavior, not exception parity. Valid receiver/CString objects and physical-service buffers do not alias this unescaped private word: constructor receivers are entry ESP-0x120/-0x11c/-0x118, source strings are original read-only data, GetCurrentDirectoryA receives only ESP-0x10c with capacity 255 (ending at ESP-0xe), and nested OpenFile receives a lower 136-byte OFSTRUCT. CString constructor 0x4f65f2 and allocator helper 0x4f6480 access their own lower frames, the selected CString word and allocated heap, never the parent state; lstrlenA reads only its source, and allocation returns fresh heap. No physical fixture is allowed to inspect unrelated private parent stack. Moving state 0 before the data constructor preserves its receiver, string, allocation and event order; only the exception state during that constructor changes. Both normal exits overwrite the low byte with 1 before movie destruction, then 0 before high-resolution destruction, then the full word with -1 before data destruction (0x42cd2f/0x42cd40/0x42cd51 and 0x42cd69/0x42cd7a/0x42cd8b). Thus calls, heap, globals, lifetime and return value are identical for every permitted normal-return input; only excluded guest exception dispatch could distinguish this mutant.

limits: GetCurrentDirectoryA supplies the current directory through a physical-service fixture.
OpenFile supplies file-existence status and OFSTRUCT bytes through a physical-service fixture.
lstrlenA and InterlockedDecrement fixtures implement only the imported string and atomic operations.
Operator new and delete use the comparison allocator.
The unchanged drive-discovery helper is exercised through its cached-drive path; the unchanged display-mode helper is exercised through its early-return paths.
Legacy source files remain unchanged; canonical recovery owns both historical archive-path entry functions.
notes: Reviewed full legacy surface: archive path resolution and file existence.
